column3: With respect to the Olive Industrial 4-Pack Mortgage Loan (6.8%), the Phase I ESA for the Joplin Property identified a REC arising from potential groundwater contamination related to historical mining. The environmental consultant reported that the Joplin Property is in the Oronogo-Duenweg Mining Belt, where lead, zinc and cadmium ores were previously mined, milled and smelted. The environmental consultant reported that no mining activities were recorded as having occurred at the Joplin Property or in the immediate vicinity of the Joplin Property and a 2024 water quality report did not identify concentrations of lead above the applicable regulatory criteria at the Joplin Property. The environmental consultant concluded that the Joplin Property’s inclusion within the Oronogo-Duenweg Mining Belt represents a REC. The environmental consultant further concluded that the parties responsible for the REC were identified, none of whom owned or operated the Joplin Property and that no further investigation was necessary in relation to the REC at the Joplin Property. The environmental consultant recommended cooperation with the applicable regulatory agencies for future monitoring and remediation activities.
